formalized_ms: Uniform Cartier sections for Fano type contractions
gap: Lean is only a compactness lemma for chart-field retractions; neither uniform Cartier sections nor bounded klt complements with index N(d,eps) are stated.
quote: Uniform Cartier sections, bounded klt complements, and the paper's real-boundary and companion conclusions are outside this supporting statement.

formalized_ms: Approximate counting of common bases of two matroids
gap: Headline counts common integer bases of two integral polymatroids with binary capacities via rank oracles; Lean is only the 0/1 matroid common-bases case.
quote: The formalized result gives a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for the number of common bases of two equal-rank matroids on an enumerated finite ground set, using independence oracles.

formalized_ms: Ergodicity of triangular billiards with an irrational angle
gap: Headline is weak mixing (ergodicity of the product flow); Lean states only ergodicity. The note never says weak mixing is not formalized.
quote: The formalization proves that the unit-speed billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with at least one angle irrational relative to $\pi$ is ergodic for normalized area times uniform angular measure.

formalized_ms: A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound
gap: Lean gives the n^{-2+eta} bound only along an unbounded sequence n_j, not every large n, and uses a smaller exponent than the paper's eta.
quote: The linked construction is for an unbounded sequence of sizes; the paper's statement for every sufficiently large $n$ is broader.

formalized_ms: Quadratic stabilization of the canonical Foulkes--Howe map
gap: Lean gives Foulkes-Howe surjectivity for b>=a(a-1), so the sixth case only for b>=30; headline embedding for 6<=b<30 is missing.
quote: The sixth-power specialization is covered for $b\ge30$; the companion's full range $b\ge6$ is not included.

formalized_ms: Cutoff throughout the high-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick phase
gap: Lean has discrete ratio cutoff only for beta<1/2, with no location or continuous time. Its spectral-gap and beta>=1 comparators are not implied by the headline.
quote: The paper's full range $\beta<1$, explicit cutoff location, and continuous-time conclusion are outside this selected statement.

formalized_ms: An infinite finitely presented periodic group
gap: Lean has an infinite f.p. periodic St_12(R) but no residual finiteness and no 2-power element orders. The note flags only the omitted nil-algebra results.
quote: The formalization gives a negative answer by constructing an infinite finitely presented periodic group, including a witness realized as a Steinberg group over an algebra of characteristic two.

formalized_ms: Exact Fourier certificates for complex Hadamard matrices of order six
gap: Lean has N(6)<=5 plus Fourier vanishing, which N(6)=3 does not imply, so the label is different. The bound of three is missing.
quote: The selected statement does not establish the paper's upper bound of three or its computer-assisted exclusion of four arbitrary bases.

formalized_ms: QAOA attains the SK ground-state energy in the thermodynamic-first limit
gap: Lean has Parisi value identities (conditional on a minimizer) and companion full support; nothing about QAOA circuit energies converging to the SK ground state.
quote: The selected statement covers these value and approximation results; it does not itself assert convergence of QAOA circuit energies.

formalized_ms: Relative independence of the separable quotient problem
gap: Lean has only CH implies not SQ over R and C. The consistency of SQ (from a measurable cardinal) and hence independence are missing.
quote: This is the conditional counterexample direction. The positive consistency direction and the paper's full relative-independence conclusions are outside the selected statement.

formalized_ms: Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation
gap: Lean solutions conserve only local mass and total momentum, satisfy an energy inequality, and are L1-continuous only initially. The headline has exact local conservation throughout.
quote: These are the conditions of the selected periodic result; later local-conservation refinements are outside it.
